001-empty-rects.json.note: An empty rects list makes the whole strip click-through.

002-kind-resident.json.note: One resident rect with no agent.

003-kind-building.json.note: One building rect with no agent.

004-kind-bell.json.note: One bell rect with no agent.

005-kind-card.json.note: One card rect with no agent.

006-kind-ui.json.note: One ui rect with no agent.

007-kind-other.json.note: One other rect with no agent.

008-kind-resident-with-agent.json.note: One resident rect carrying a salted agent id.

009-kind-building-with-agent.json.note: One building rect carrying a salted agent id.

010-kind-bell-with-agent.json.note: One bell rect carrying a salted agent id.

011-kind-card-with-agent.json.note: One card rect carrying a salted agent id.

012-kind-ui-with-agent.json.note: One ui rect carrying a salted agent id.

013-kind-other-with-agent.json.note: One other rect carrying a salted agent id.

014-agent-without-kind.json.note: A rect with an agent id but no kind.

015-geometry-only.json.note: A rect with geometry only and no diagnostics.

022-viewport-min-extent.json.note: A viewport extent just above zero with an empty rects list.

023-viewport-max-extent.json.note: A viewport at the 16384 pixel maximum with a rect in its far corner.

024-viewport-fractional.json.note: A viewport with fractional logical pixel sizes.

025-rect-origin.json.note: A rect at the origin of the content area.

026-rect-full-viewport.json.note: A rect covering the whole viewport.

027-rect-tiny-extent.json.note: A rect with a width just above zero.

028-rect-max-extent.json.note: A rect whose width is the 16384 maximum, in a viewport of the same width.

029-rect-coord-max.json.note: x at the 16384 coordinate maximum; the rect sits past the viewport edge, which only the producer invariant forbids.

030-rect-fractional-geometry.json.note: Fractional logical pixel geometry is allowed.

037-t-at-min.json.note: t at the minimum legal timestamp.

038-t-at-max.json.note: t at the maximum legal timestamp.

039-mixed-kinds-and-agents.json.note: Several rects of different kinds, some with agents, in one message.

001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object, not an array.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object, not null.

003-root-string.json.note: The root must be an object, not a string.

009-missing-rects.json.note: rects is required, even when empty.

011-t-in-seconds.json.note: t in seconds is below the millisecond range.

014-t-string.json.note: t must be an integer, not an ISO timestamp string.

015-extra-top-level-field.json.note: An unknown top-level field is rejected by the closed object.

016-surface-ambient.json.note: Only the strip is partly click-through in v0.1, so ambient is rejected.

017-surface-popover.json.note: Only the strip is partly click-through in v0.1, so popover is rejected.

018-viewport-missing-w.json.note: viewport requires both w and h.

019-viewport-missing-h.json.note: viewport requires both w and h.

020-viewport-extra-dpi.json.note: viewport is a closed object; device pixel ratio belongs in scale.

021-viewport-w-zero.json.note: A viewport extent must be above zero.

022-viewport-h-negative.json.note: A viewport extent must be above zero.

023-viewport-w-over-max.json.note: A viewport extent is at most 16384.

024-viewport-h-string.json.note: A viewport extent must be a number, not a string.

025-viewport-w-null.json.note: A viewport extent is required and cannot be null.

028-scale-string.json.note: scale must be a number, not a string.

030-rects-null.json.note: rects is always present as an array, never null.

032-rect-missing-h.json.note: A rect requires x, y, w and h.

033-rect-missing-x.json.note: A rect requires x, y, w and h.

034-rect-x-negative.json.note: A rect x coordinate is at least 0.

035-rect-x-over-max.json.note: A rect x coordinate is at most 16384.

036-rect-y-string.json.note: A rect y coordinate must be a number.

037-rect-w-zero.json.note: A rect width must be above zero.

038-rect-h-negative.json.note: A rect height must be above zero.

039-rect-kind-unknown.json.note: rect kind must be one of the six kinds.

040-rect-kind-null.json.note: rect kind is omitted when unknown, never null.

041-rect-agent-raw-uuid.json.note: A rect agent is a salted id, never a raw UUID.

042-rect-agent-uppercase.json.note: A rect agent id must be lowercase hex.

043-rect-agent-null.json.note: A rect agent is omitted when unknown, never null.

044-rect-unknown-field.json.note: A rect carries geometry and two diagnostics only, so a label is rejected.

045-rect-null-item.json.note: Each rect must be an object, not null.

046-third-rect-zero-width.json.note: The third rect has a zero width, so the error points at index 2.
